# Stone Wing

Website: https://spindleandstone.com

Stone Wing is a governed desktop AI workspace for Mac and Windows. It brings multiple AI providers, files, MCP-compatible tools, routing, Bridge-connected computers, and approval/governance controls into one interface.

Key concepts:
- macOS Build89 released
- Windows Build90 released
- Multiple supported AI providers
- Manual and automatic model routing
- Files and project context
- MCP tools
- Bridge-connected computers
- Governance and approval controls
- Supported provider free-tier access where available

Launch status: macOS Build89 released. Windows Build90 released with Microsoft PublicTrust signing and production acceptance.
Pricing: $99 CAD one-time license or $9.99 CAD/month subscription.
Cloudflare Workers AI is deferred from Build89 and is not shown in the shipped provider list.

Official source: https://spindleandstone.com
